notes.note: Searching a member number that does not exist returns the Member Inquiry screen with the exact text "No member records matched your search." — a legitimate business result, not an error.
Notes is optional on the Place Account Hold form: submitting with Notes blank still reaches CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD and shows "Notes: (none)".

The Place Account Hold form is labelled "RESTRICTED FUNCTION - SUPERVISOR OVERRIDE REQUIRED"; it was reachable with the supervisor operator super1. A non-supervisor operator (e.g. teller1) would likely be refused — wording not observed. The capability deliberately STOPS at the CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD review screen and does not click "Apply Hold", which is flagged IRREVERSIBLE ACTION.

finish.name: Place Account Hold Request (to confirmation screen)
finish.description: Signs on to Meridian Core as a supervisor operator, looks up a member by member number, opens the Place Account Hold action, fills in share, reason code and notes, and submits to reach the CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD review screen (banner: IRREVERSIBLE ACTION). It stops there without applying the hold, and returns the reviewed member, share, reason and notes for human approval. Returns a business outcome if no member matches the number supplied.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator ID used to sign on (must have supervisor rights for the hold function).

inputs.name: memberNumber
inputs.description: Member number to place the hold on.

inputs.name: shareId
inputs.description: Visible option text of the share in the Share dropdown, e.g. '100987-S0001 - Regular Shares'.

inputs.name: reasonCode
inputs.description: Hold reason code, as shown in the Reason Code dropdown.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.description: Free-text justification notes for the hold (optional; blank shows as '(none)').

outputs.name: member
outputs.description: Member number and name shown on the confirmation screen.
outputs.label: Member:

outputs.name: share
outputs.description: Share the hold would apply to.
outputs.label: Share:

businessOutcomes.title: No member matched the member number
businessOutcomes.detectValue: No member records matched your search.
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: Verify the member number with the requester.

businessOutcomes.title: Hold was committed instead of stopping at review
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: The capability must stop at the CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD screen; if a hold was actually applied, review the member's shares and the audit log immediately.

businessOutcomes.title: Operator lacks supervisor rights for the hold function
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: Wording inferred, not observed. Re-run with a supervisor operator ID such as super1.
